data.long_description:
Provident proudly presents a newly constructed 2 bedroom apartment for rent at Address Harbour Point. Designed to offer opulent and cozy living, Address Harbour Point serves as a captivating entrance to Dubai Creek Harbour. With uninterrupted vistas of the iconic Dubai Creek Tower and the Downtown Dubai skyline, coupled with effortless access to the marina, park, and pier, residents are poised to relish the myriad activities Dubai Creek Harbour offers.

Property Details:

• Condition: Brand New
• Bedrooms: 2
• Bathrooms: 2
• Furnishing: Furnished
• View: Full Park View, Partial Creek View

Amenities:

• Basement Parking
• Built-in Wardrobes
• Central Air Conditioning
• Covered Parking
• Gymnasium
• Kitchen Appliances
• Shops & Restaurants
• Swimming Pool
